KNOWLEDGE_RAG.notes: ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH as a returned status is a routing outcome, counted matched by the frozen dispatch evaluator when the capability matches; it is not converted to another capability's status.

GENERAL.source: sciencemath/executive/state.py EVIDENCE_STATUSES + uncertainty.decide_status + fast path (frozen runtime taxonomy; no UNKNOWN member)

OK.meaning: capability completed with full support (DOCUMENT success path)

PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED.meaning: evidence-bearing but not fully verified; also the unverified fast-path status

UNCERTAIN.meaning: no usable-evidence signals, verification unverified; honest cannot-determine

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.related_internal_name: INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION is the executive runtime's abstention status name (distinct vocabulary, adjudicated as the executive's abstention status; both remain valid, neither is renamed)

rules: MUST NOT terminate a dispatch in T25: every runtime terminal carries a defined status derived from its recorded signal vector
remains valid as an internal axis value (classification axes, verify verdicts, provenance, trust classes)
the frozen dispatch evaluator rule (non-empty defined string expected; UNKNOWN => unmatched, zero tolerance) is retained UNCHANGED as the permanent guard
no conversion of any historical T24 row status is performed or possible (T24 store immutable)
no current runtime path emits ERROR as a capability status and T25 does not introduce one

hard runtime failures surface either as the capability's own defined status with failure_category/termination_reason recorded, or abort the row via ProductionDispatchError (protocol-visible exception), never as a fabricated status

boundary_rules.statement: A dispatch that terminates must carry exactly one status from its capability's closed set; 'status absent' is not a status and must not reach the evaluator.

Terminal statuses may come only from the capability runtime's own recorded epistemic signals (frozen uncertainty engine over the run's observations), never from adapter invention or model self-assessment.
UNKNOWN never crosses the runtime-to-protocol boundary as a terminal status; the frozen evaluator UNKNOWN=>unmatched rule is the enforcement backstop and is not modified.
Deriving a status never erases the failure cause: termination_reason, failure_category, and error fields are recorded in the packed result exactly as before.
unknown / missing / malformed / non-string / empty status values at the dispatch boundary fail closed (negative controls); nondeterministic status assignment for identical inputs is a defect.
Floors, thresholds, zero-tolerance conditions, scorer semantics, and the dispatch matching rule are untouched by this contract; only the runtime's status assignment is remediated.

forbidden_conversions: UNKNOWN -> UNCERTAIN or PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED solely to satisfy the T24 aggregate
counting UNKNOWN as matched by changing the capability-matching rule
reducing any capability floor or removing any zero-tolerance condition
